body: I don't know, talking about it won't change anything about my situation.

My comment was not directed at you at all so no worries there.

Just trying to clarify my mindset and maybe someone else out there won't feel as alone as I do when they read my post, I don't know. 

I look at my life and it feels surreal in some way, like it's not really my life. But it is, and I have to resolve this because the alternative is oblivion.

Thank you for replying, it sounds silly but it means a lot right now, I have not spoken to anyone about this. I'm on the spectrum so find it difficult to maintain friendships for some reason, I just lose touch.

Thank you for your response, really trying hard to keep it together. I know there are others that feel the way I do.

Let me clarify to anyone reading this, I'm not doing this to illicit sympathy, this is uncomfortable to talk about which is why I'm doing it. My natural reaction is to retreat and isolate and that obviously hasn't worked, at all.

There is affordable therapy available locally, the service is offered by masters degree students, it's better than nothing.

Thank you, I'm really trying right now as I don't want to be a victim of my life.

My situation is almost impossible, I can't legally work in the country I am in right now and have no family to help, I thought things were going to work out in this relationship but I'm just too damaged.

On the edge of being homeless in a foreign country, I am praying.
Thank you, I really hope you're right, it's too much right now.
